name: Sofa Bubbles - 3 Seater Sofa (Fabric, Teal Blue)
description: Meet the Bubbles Sofa: the unofficial meeting spot of your home. It’s where chai turns into long conversations, quick sits turn into hour-long catch-ups, and “just five minutes” never really means five minutes. Made for compact homes, shared apartments, and first homes, Bubbles fits right in without trying too hard. The luxury-touch polyester fabric feels soft and inviting, while the 6” ultra-plush foam gives you that sink-in comfort that makes standing up feel optional. The sloped wooden legs keep things light, airy, and easy to clean underneath, because comfort shouldn’t come with extra chores. It comes with a 3-year warranty so you can relax knowing Bubbles is built for everyday life, not just good looks. Bubbles has a way of turning short breaks into long hangs. And honestly? That's kind of the point. It’s where plans are made, gossip is shared, and “last episode” turns into three more. Don’t be surprised if your gang forgets they were ever planning to leave!

contentSections.heading: FAQs
contentSections.text: FAQs 1.What is Sofa Bubbles? Sofa Bubbles is a fabric sofa from Sleepyhead, designed with a “sink‑in” mid‑century look, 6‑inch curated foam seating, and sloped wooden legs to create a light‑looking, plush unit for small living rooms. 2.What are its unique features? It features 360 GSM polyester fabric with a soft, “luxury‑touch” feel, 6‑inch layered foam for ultra plush seating, sloped wooden legs that make vacuuming underneath easier, and a 3‑year conditional warranty. 3.Is professional installation/assembly included with Sofa Bubbles? Yes; the installation is provided by Sleepyhead Experts. 4.What are the space requirements for Sofa Bubbles? Sofa Bubbles measures 206.5 cm (length) × 84 cm (depth) × 93.5 cm (height), so you should allow at least 207 cm of wall length plus about 10–20 cm clearance on each side and in front for comfortable movement and easy access. 5.What warranty comes with Sofa Bubbles? Sofa Bubbles comes with a 3‑year conditional warranty. 6.Can I try the Sofa Bubbles before purchasing? Yes, you can try this at your nearest Sleepyhead store. 7.Is the Sofa Bubbles customizable (fabric, color, configuration)? Sofa Bubbles is offered in multiple colours (Canyon Rose, Flint Grey, Teal Blue) and in 2‑seater and 3‑seater sizes. But currently we do not offer other customisation options. 8.What seating configurations are available for Sofa Bubbles? Sofa Bubbles is available as a 2‑seater and a 3‑seater standalone sofa. 9.How do I clean and maintain Sofa Bubbles? Clean using a soft, dry or slightly damp cloth for dust and light spills; for stains, blot (do not rub) with a mild, non‑bleach detergent solution on a damp cloth, then wipe with a clean, dry cloth. The 360 GSM polyester fabric and sloped wooden legs help resist wear and aid cleaning, but you should avoid harsh chemicals, sharp objects, and prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the sofa’s colour and comfort
